messages:
Leah (CS): Quick capture from today's MedLink finance call. Two urgent asks: per-route billing CSV and stable export identifiers for audits. They said renewal discussion hinges on this.
Leah (CS): Customer quote: "We can't map charges to internal ledgers without route IDs and export_id — it's a hard stop for procurement."
olivia (CS): Adding context: procurement wants samples before Friday. Renewal touchpoint scheduled next Tues.
Ravi (PM): OK label: per-route CSV = P0, export_id/meta = P1. Any quick mitigations?
Sam (Eng): We can produce a one-off reconciled CSV from staging that includes route_id and per-route totals. Low effort. I'll need the sample export file.
Leah (CS): I'll upload the sample and permission now. Also they're seeing occasional truncated long notes in the transcript exports; said it affects compliance docs.
Sam (Eng): Noted. Truncation might be prompt length vs encoder limit. Can spike a repro if you attach the long note example.
Ravi (PM): Who owns tickets? Leah for customer comms and follow-up; Sam to generate manual CSV + spike truncation. I'll take ownership of adding stable export_id to the schema.
event-bot: Created tasks ML-3321 (manual-reconciled-csv), ML-3322 (export-id-schema), ML-3323 (transcript-truncation-repro). Linked to workspace "MedLink-Pilot" and flagged ML-3321 as P0.
olivia (CS): Short-term ask: Sam, can you confirm ETA for the manual CSV? Procurement needs it today ideally.
Sam (Eng): ETA 4 hours if I get the sample. Will add per-route totals and a checksum field for audit.
Leah (CS): Thanks — I'll attach sample now and ping procurement. Updating account renewal-risk to "high" until deliverable shipped.
Ravi (PM): We'll review progress in tomorrow standup. Thanks team :thumbsup:
